warranty.title: What happens when a size or stitch fails?
warranty.description: Approvals are tied to a style and PO — not promised after the goods leave the factory.
warranty.commitment: Every measurement claim is checked against the signed size spec and AQL report that travels with the cartons.

cases.question: If fit drifts in bulk
cases.title: Rework or hold the PO against the signed sample.
cases.description: Bulk cutting starts only after the fit sample is approved. Out-of-tolerance sizes are flagged before packing.

cases.question: If shrinkage exceeds the spec
cases.title: Wash test before PP approval.
cases.description: Fabric and garment wash results are written into the tech pack. Failed lots do not move to bulk.

cases.question: If cartons arrive short
cases.title: Packing list reconciles pieces vs. PO.
cases.description: Every carton is counted at final inspection. Shortage claims are resolved against the signed packing list.
